name: efforts: unit-test the client efforts API module
description:
Why: the pending working-tree change adds `client/src/api/modules/efforts.js` and `client/src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue` with no test at all (`tests/` only covers markdown parser, browser collab/annotations, meet peers). The QA gate on the working tree is stuck at `require_approval` partly because changed sources are unmapped to tests.

Scope (one increment, this card only):
- Add `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`, dependency free, same style as `tests/blockEditing.test.mjs` (local `test()` helper, `node:assert/strict`, run as `node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`).
- Cover only the pure contract of `src/api/modules/efforts.js` against a fake API object: path building (`/api/efforts/{encodeURIComponent(trim(name))}`), verbs (`GET /api/efforts`, `GET /api/efforts/fields`, `GET /api/efforts/{name}`, `POST /api/efforts`, `PUT /api/efforts/{name}`, `DELETE /api/efforts/{name}`) and the payload passed through unchanged.
- No production file is modified. Do not touch the feature code, do not widen to the Vue component.

Acceptance criteria:
- `node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (cwd `client/`) exits 0 and prints one `ok - ` line per case.
- A failing assertion makes the process exit non-zero.
- Evidence (command + output) is commented on the card and the card is moved to Review; the card is never closed by its owner.

messages.content: Take this card, work one increment only: add `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` covering the pure contract of `src/api/modules/efforts.js` (paths + verbs + payload passthrough) against a fake API object. Run `node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` from `client/` and comment the changed files plus the command output as validation evidence. Do not modify production files, do not widen the scope, and move the card to Review when the increment is done.

## Increment 1 — test file added, execution blocked by tooling

**Changed files**
- `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (new, 128 lines) — dependency-free contract tests for `client/src/api/modules/efforts.js`, same style as `tests/blockEditing.test.mjs` (local `test()` helper, `node:assert/strict`, `process.exitCode = failed ? 1 : 0`).
- No production file touched (`src/api/modules/efforts.js` only read; already registered in `src/api/api.js:11`).

**Coverage of the module contract (8 cases)**
1. `list()` → `GET /api/efforts`
2. `fields()` → `GET /api/efforts/fields`
3. `load('fast')` → `GET /api/efforts/fast`
4. `load('  big model/v2  ')` → `GET /api/efforts/big%20model%2Fv2` (trim + `encodeURIComponent`)
5. `create(effort)` → `POST /api/efforts`, payload passed by reference
6. `save('fast', effort)` → `PUT /api/efforts/fast`, payload passed by reference
7. `delete('fast')` → `DELETE /api/efforts/fast`
8. two module instances keep separate API call logs

**Validation evidence — NOT executed, blocker recorded**
- Command to run: `cd client && node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (expected: 8 × `ok - …`, exit 0).
- `docker exec codx-junior-api node --version` → exit 126, `node: executable file not found in $PATH`.
- Same result on `codx-junior-client`, `cj-buildcheck`, `cj-imgtest`, `computer_670d7572` (desktop).
- `docker exec codx-junior-api apt-get install -y -qq nodejs` → exit 100, `Permission denied` on `/var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend` (docker exec runs as non-root).
- No shell/command tool is granted to this profile and `qa_run_tests` only exposes the `pytest` suite, so the .mjs runner cannot be executed from this shift.

**Ask for the reviewer / human**
Run `cd client && node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` on a machine with Node ≥ 18 and post the output. If any case fails, the fix belongs in `efforts.js`, not in the test. Follow-up card with a wake scheduled for tomorrow.

## Increment 2 — static contract review of the new test (no runtime needed)

**Changed files:** none in this increment. Reviewed:
- `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (the increment 1 deliverable, 110 lines)
- `client/src/api/modules/efforts.js` (96 lines, unchanged — only read)

**Review evidence** (source-to-assertion mapping, checked line by line):

| test case | module call | matches |
|---|---|---|
| `list()` | `API.get('/api/efforts')` | ✅ |
| `fields()` | `API.get('/api/efforts/fields')` | ✅ |
| `load('fast')` | `API.get(effortPath(name))` → `/api/efforts/fast` | ✅ |
| `load('  big model/v2  ')` | `trim()` + `encodeURIComponent` → `/api/efforts/big%20model%2Fv2` | ✅ |
| `create(effort)` | `API.post('/api/efforts', effort)`, payload by reference | ✅ |
| `save('fast', effort)` | `API.put('/api/efforts/fast', effort)`, payload by reference | ✅ |
| `delete('fast')` | `async delete(name) { await API.delete(effortPath(name)) }` — call recorded synchronously before the `await` | ✅ |
| instance isolation | `effortsModule(API)` closes over its own `API`, no module-level state | ✅ |

**Runner convention confirmed:** `client/package.json` has **no `test` script** (scripts: dev, build, preview, build-only, type-check, lint, format, docs:*). Every suite in `client/tests/` is ad hoc, discovered by `project_locate("node tests/")` → `blockEditing`, `browserAnnotations`, `browserCollab`, `fileChangeParser`, `meetPeers`, all documenting `node tests/<file>.test.mjs`. The new file follows that convention exactly (own `test()` helper, `ok - ` / `not ok - ` lines, `process.exitCode`).

**Still not executed:** this profile exposes no shell/container tool in this turn, and node is absent from `codx-junior-api`, `codx-junior-client`, `computer_670d7572`, `cj-buildcheck`, `cj-imgtest` (exit 126) — root is unavailable to apt-get inside them (exit 100, dpkg lock). Execution is owned by follow-up card `a0f362ed-42d4-43e9-84f1-833982a69002` (IT team / Scheduled), now annotated with the exact `docker run … node:22-alpine` command.

Card left in **Review**, not closed.

## Increment 3 — response contract pinned + one defect found (test file changed, still not executed)

**Changed files**
- `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (+1 case, 8 → **9** cases; harness now awaits async cases): new test `load/create/save propagate the response, delete() resolves undefined`, plus the runner tail `Promise.all(pending).then(...)` so a rejected assertion still exits non-zero.
- No production file touched.

**Why this increment**
The static review in increment 2 checked URLs and verbs but not the *response* half of the contract, and that half is what the only consumer depends on. Reading the consumer (`src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue`) gave the missing piece:
- `load()` / `save()` → lines 253-256, 336-341 use the resolved value (`docs.fields`, `saved.name`);
- `assertOk()` (lines 352-357) rejects `!response`, `response.status_code`, and requires `response.name || response.deleted`;
- `remove()` (lines 358-372) does `this.assertOk(await api.delete(this.draft.name))`.

**Validation evidence — static, source-to-assertion (NOT a test run)**
| Test case | Source line | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `list()` → `GET /api/efforts` | `efforts.js:44` `return API.get('/api/efforts')` | match |
| `fields()` → `GET /api/efforts/fields` | `efforts.js:53` | match |
| `load()` → `GET /api/efforts/{name}`, trim + encode | `efforts.js:30-31` `effortPath` + `:61` | match |
| `create()` → `POST`, payload by reference | `efforts.js:70` | match |
| `save()` → `PUT`, payload by reference | `efforts.js:81` | match |
| `delete()` → `DELETE` | `efforts.js:88-90` `async … await API.delete(...)` | match |
| `load/create/save` propagate, `delete` → `undefined` | `efforts.js:61/70/81` return the promise; `:89` `await` swallows | match (new) |
| per-instance isolation | `efforts.js:37` factory closure | match |

Execution is still impossible with this profile: `docker exec codx-junior-api node --version` → exit 126 (`node: executable file not found`), same in `codx-junior-client`, `cj-buildcheck`, `cj-imgtest`, `computer_670d7572`; `apt-get install -y -qq nodejs` → exit 100 (dpkg frontend lock, non-root); HTTP probes of `:8000` / `:8001` / `:19980` → Errno 111. Follow-up card `a0f362ed-42d4-43e9-84f1-833982a69002` (wake 2026-11-19T08:56Z) carries the refined command and must now expect **9** `ok - ` lines.

**Defect found (out of this card's scope, filed separately)**
`EffortsSettings.remove()` calls `assertOk(await api.delete(name))`, but `effortsModule.delete()` resolves `undefined` — identical to the pre-existing `profiles.delete` convention (`src/api/api.js:900-902`). So `assertOk(undefined)` throws `The server rejected the request` on **every** delete, after the server already deleted the effort, and `load()` never runs. New card: `fcf65219-72bf-4c84-ace5-5e10bb78a8fa` (IT team / Inbox, high). I did not fix it here to respect the card scope — the new test pins the current `undefined` behaviour so either fix is visible.

**Card state** — kept in Review, `status=doing`, `progress=70`, owner does not close its own card.

## Increment 4 — test file re-read against source, 9/9 cases verified (still not executed)

Re-read the current `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (141 lines) and `client/src/api/modules/efforts.js` (96 lines) line by line. Every case now maps to the implementation:

| # | Test case (test file) | Source it pins |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `list() GETs /api/efforts` (L59) | `efforts.js:44-46` `return API.get('/api/efforts')` |
| 2 | `fields() GETs /api/efforts/fields` (L65) | `efforts.js:53-55` |
| 3 | `load() GETs /api/efforts/{name}` (L71) | `efforts.js:62-64` |
| 4 | trim + encode `'  big model/v2  '` → `/api/efforts/big%20model%2Fv2` (L77) | `effortPath()` = `encodeURIComponent(name.trim())` |
| 5 | `create() POSTs /api/efforts`, payload by identity (L86, asserts `args[1] === effort`) | `efforts.js:71-73` |
| 6 | `save() PUTs /api/efforts/{name}`, payload by identity (L94) | `efforts.js:81-83` |
| 7 | `delete() DELETEs /api/efforts/{name}` (L105) | `efforts.js:91-93` (URL built synchronously before the `await`, so the sync assertion is sound) |
| 8 | async contract: `load/create/save` return the envelope, `delete` → `undefined` (L111-129) | `return API.get/post/put(...)` vs `async delete(){ await API.delete(...) }` |
| 9 | per-instance isolation (L131) | factory closes over its own `API` |

**Harness soundness checked explicitly** (this was the risk of the async rewrite): a test returning a thenable is queued with `result.then(ok, ko)`, `ko` increments the shared `failed`, and `process.exitCode` is set only inside `Promise.all(pending).then(...)` (L139-141) — i.e. after every handler has run, so a rejected assertion does reach the exit code. Empty `pending` resolves in a microtask and still sets the code.

**Expected output unchanged: exactly 9 `ok - ` lines, exit 0.**
Command (from `client/`): `node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`.

**Still unexecuted — blocker unchanged since increment 1:** no `node` in any reachable container (`codx-junior-api`, `codx-junior-client`, `computer_670d7572`, `cj-buildcheck`, `cj-imgtest` → exit 126), `apt-get install nodejs` → exit 100 (dpkg lock, non-root), live endpoints `localhost:8000/8001/19980` → Errno 111. The execution follow-up is card `a0f362ed-42d4-43e9-84f1-833982a69002` (wake_at 2026-11-19T08:56:33Z).

**Scope:** no production file touched by this card. The only deliverable is `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`; the defect it exposed lives on `fcf65219-72bf-4c84-ace5-5e10bb78a8fa` and was not worked here.

Acceptance `cd client && node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` -> exit 0 with 9 x `ok - ` is unverified: no `node` binary in codx-junior-api / codx-junior-client / cj-buildcheck / cj-imgtest images, no `test` script in client/package.json, and qa_policy declares no node suite

**Failing test ids:** none — 0 tests selected, 0 failed. This is not a red test, it is a missing runtime.

**Static review of the artifact (positive, for the record):** 9 cases, dependency-free `node:assert/strict`, non-vacuous assertions — `list/fields/load/create/save/delete` verbs and paths, `trim` + `encodeURIComponent('  big model/v2  ')` -> `big%20model%2Fv2`, payload passed by reference (`assert.equal(lastCall(API).args[1], effort)`), response envelope propagation, `delete()` resolving `undefined`, and per-instance call isolation. `process.exitCode = failed ? 1 : 0` makes a failed assertion exit non-zero. The file is a valid test; only the run is missing.

**Gap to close before this card can be accepted**
1. Execute the file once with a real node runtime and paste the 9 `ok - ` lines + `echo $?` = 0 on this card. Any node >= 18 works (`node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`, no deps).
2. Either declare the client suite so the gate can run it (needs a runtime in the image) or record it as an environment finding with a dated owner. Follow-up already scheduled: `a0f362ed` (IT team / Scheduled, wake 2026-11-19T08:56Z) — do not duplicate it.

No test was skipped, deleted or weakened; the defect warning from the earlier comment (`EffortsSettings.remove()` asserting on `delete()`'s `undefined`) is tracked in `fcf65219` and is deliberately out of scope here.
